scope: Research/install audit; numerical source identities remain in the referenced manifests, not duplicated here.

sources.name: SPICE
sources.coverage_and_limits: Supported UTC kernel intersection; geometric directions for confirmed lunar coordinates.

sources.name: JPL Horizons
sources.coverage_and_limits: 36 preserved comparisons; shared JPL heritage, not independent observational validation.

sources.name: Global LOLA / ODE
sources.status: catalog research; not a global installed DEM
sources.coverage_and_limits: Global products require verified frame, scaling, masks, resolution and bounded local ingestion.

sources.name: SLDEM2015
sources.coverage_and_limits: Product latitude support is 60 S to 60 N. Large tiles were not ingested; cite Barker et al. (2015) if used.

sources.name: PGDA regional south-polar terrain
sources.coverage_and_limits: Published DE421 south-polar COG DEM, slope, effective-resolution and error products. No new regional raster installed.

sources.name: PGDA 87–90 S terrain
sources.coverage_and_limits: Large 5 m south-polar DEM; no claim of local installation or globally complete horizon.

sources.name: PGDA high-resolution study sites
sources.coverage_and_limits: Original Site01 plus thirteen 325 m native 5 m windows; actual four-neighbor support required. Quality samples are context, not propagated uncertainty.

sources.name: PGDA polar illumination and Earth visibility
sources.coverage_and_limits: Three 3.9 km windows near Site01, 60 m pixels; approximately 18.6-year any-disk model, not mission-date sunlight or center-only DTE.

sources.name: LROC imagery and Apollo stereo terrain
sources.status: imagery integrated; Apollo terrain metadata only
sources.coverage_and_limits: Optical context does not measure terrain heights. Apollo stereo frame/vertical registration remains unverified locally.

sources.name: NASA Moon Trek
sources.status: imagery tile service and external reference; not a numerical engine
sources.coverage_and_limits: The existing 2D maps and 3D context globe use official WMTS photographic tiles. No Moon Trek-derived terrain, illumination or engineering values enter local calculations. Uncached images need the service; local scientific analysis does not.

sources.name: Diviner
sources.coverage_and_limits: Official archive describes RDR 3.1 and global/polar thermal maps. No temperature, heater sizing or thermal survival calculation installed.

sources.name: USGS lunar geology
sources.coverage_and_limits: No geological map or hazard inference integrated. Product-specific registration and attribution remain required.
